issues.detail: The Greek phrase 'ο εστιν δωρον ο εαν εξ εμου ωφεληθης' translates to 'it is a gift if it is from me,' but the Vietnamese translation adds the concept 'không còn phải giúp cha mẹ nữa' (no longer has to help/provide for parents), which is an interpretation of the implication rather than a literal rendering of the text provided.
